tijori.business_description: Aastha Spintex Limited, incorporated in 2013, operates in the textile manufacturing segment, engaged in the production and trading of cotton yarn and cotton bales. The company manufactures carded, combed, and compact combed cotton yarns for knitting and weaving applications.
